inference_features.content: 92 contextual features plus source-free within-frame/video relative ranks

positive_only_models.normalization: equal-source weighted positive median and interquartile scale
positive_only_models.family_models: one independent all-positive model per fit family

strict_nested_calibration.inner_prediction: held F1-F4 support uses only the other family models
strict_nested_calibration.held_family_cutoff: derived only from the other held families' positive-support endpoints
cutoff_rules: minimum endpoint minus cross-family endpoint range
strict_nested_calibration.outer_cutoff: same rule applied to all four inner-OOF endpoints

selection.access: F1-F4 OOF only; only the frozen inner winner is evaluated on F5
selection.winner: highest pooled official Score among candidates passing every-family and every-source safety

success: nonidentity F1-F4 winner also has zero TP/CO/Pd loss and deletes both FP events and false components on F5
stop_rule: stop the positive-support route if the selected F5 diagnostic is not safely nonidentity
